title: 'El Cromo,' Leader of CJNG-Linked 'Los Cromos' (Juchitán, Oaxaca), Arrested in Guadalajara
detail: Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch announced the arrest in Guadalajara, Jalisco of Iván 'N,' alias 'El Cromo,' leader of 'Los Cromos,' a group linked to CJNG operating in Juchitán de Zaragoza, Oaxaca. He faced arrest warrants for aggravated homicide, and the group is tied to extortion, kidnapping, and drug and arms trafficking, including the killing of a 4-year-old girl in Juchitán (a 2 million peso citizen reward had been offered). The operation involved SEMAR, SSPC, Army, National Guard, CNI and UIF with Oaxaca and Jalisco authorities. It follows the Sep 23 detention of Juchitán's municipal president and another group member.
